Definition
[$C^k$ boundary] 1. appC:C.1-def-1\group Boundary Regularity The boundary $\partial U$ is $C^k$ if, for every $x^0\in \partial U$, there are $r>0$ and $\gamma \in C^k(\mathbb R^{n-1})$ such that, after relabeling and reorienting the coordinate axes if necessary, \[ U\cap B(x^0,r) =\{ x\in B(x^0,r)\mid x_n>\gamma (x_1,\ldots ,x_{n-1})\} . \] The boundary is $C^\infty $ if it is $C^k$ for every positive integer $k$, and it is analytic if the local functions $\gamma $ are analytic.
